sentences.text:
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
 Shri P.D. Sharma, Advocate for appellants
 Mrs. M.R. Kavimandan, Agp for respondent Nos.1 and 2/Stat
 Shri A.R. Aole, Advocate h/s Shri A.S. Kulkarni, Advocate
 
Date : 02.12.2025

In the present appeal, the challenge is to the judgment and award passed by the learned Reference Court whereby it is clear that learned Reference Court has framed the issue "Whether applicant Nos.2 to 7 are having share in compensation amount".

And on this issue,
learned Reference Court recorded finding that this issue cannot be decided in the Reference.
2. The present appeal is filed before this Court under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act.
In my opinion, the issue which needs to be firstly decided in the present matter, whether the present appeal is tenable under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act or not.

3. List the matter for further consideration on 11.12.2025.
(PRAVIN S. PATIL J.) R.S. Sahare Signed by: Mrs. Ranjana Sahare Designation: PA To Honourable Judge Date: 03/12/2025 16:16:28
